title: Before we create your preview
body: The preview is made by AI image models, so the photo you chose has to leave your phone. Here is what happens.

sent.title: What we send
sent.body: Only the photo you selected for this preview. Nothing else from your camera roll or your journey.

who.title: Who processes it
who.body: fal.ai runs the image editing, using OpenAI image models.

retention.title: How long it stays
retention.body: Your original photo and the preview result are both deleted from our servers within 30 days. You can delete them sooner from the Previews tab.

choice.title: Your choice
choice.body: You can say no and still use the whole journey. Photos you take for your timeline stay on your device.

note: AI previews show a possibility. They are not a prediction of your result.
error: We could not save your choice. Check your connection and try again.
